 This gadget store is offering up to P26,000 off the iPhone Air, other devices until Nov. 22
 By
 AYIE LICSI 
 Published Nov 15, 2026 12:35 pm 
 Add PhilSTAR Life on Google
 The 11.11 sale may be over, but there are still some exciting deals on Apple devices to check out this November.
 For one, Digital Walker is celebrating the opening of its newest store at Park Triangle Mall with up to P26,000 off gadgets from Nov. 16 to 22.
 The iPhone Air is getting a big price cut from P76,990 to P50,990, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max is available for P77,990, down from P93,890.
 Meanwhile, you can score the iPhone 17 Pro for only P71,990 (from P85,890), the A16 iPad for P27,990 (from P35,990), the MacBook Neo for P44,990, and the Apple Watch SE 3 for P12,990.
 Additionally, the sale is offering discounts on iPhone cases, power banks, and other accessories from brands such as UAG, Speck, Momax, Marshall, Shokz, and Adam Elements.

 Digital Walker has other treats in store for shoppers at their new store, including 60% savings on a power bank and a free tote bag when you spend at least P3,000.
 New members of the Techbites app may also receive 100 points, and members of the Kaskasan Buddies app can unlock 5% additional savings.
 The new store is on the fourth floor of Park Triangle Mall, 32nd St. cor. 11th Ave., BGC.
